title: Single-scale change-of-variables identities for the blown-up Hausdorff measure
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, Hⁿ = μHE[n], ω_n = unitBallVolume n and V(r) := ω_n·ofReal(rⁿ) ∈ [0,∞] for r ∈ ℝ; ‖·‖ₑ is the [0,∞]-valued operator norm on MultiVector P n = Λ_n(ℝ^P), B̄ = closedBall, B = ball, and products and quotients are taken in [0,∞]. Let M ⊆ ℝ^P (= Euclid P) be an arbitrary set, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ and ζ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n arbitrary functions, a ∈ ℝ^P and λ > 0. Put N := blowUpMap a λ '' M = {λ⁻¹(x − a) : x ∈ M}, ν := Hⁿ⌞N (μHE[n].restrict N), D := dilation a λ (the contract's map y ↦ −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹y) and c := ofReal(λ⁻¹ ^ n). Assume (H) ν = c·D_#(Hⁿ⌞M), i.e. μHE[n].restrict N = ENNReal.ofReal (λ⁻¹ ^ n) • Measure.map D (μHE[n].restrict M). Then (i) ν(ℝ^P) = c·Hⁿ(M); and for every R > 0: (ii) ν(B̄_R(0)) = V(R)·(Hⁿ(M ∩ B̄_{λR}(a))/V(λR)); (iii) ν(B_R(0)) = V(R)·(Hⁿ(M ∩ B_{λR}(a))/V(λR)); (iv) ∫⁻_{B̄_R(0)} ‖θ(a + λy)ζ(a + λy) − θ(a)ζ(a)‖ₑ dν(y) = V(R)·((∫⁻_{M ∩ B̄_{λR}(a)} ‖θ(x)ζ(x) − θ(a)ζ(a)‖ₑ dHⁿ(x))/V(λR)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ζ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → μHE[n].restrict (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap a lam '' M) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) (μHE[n].restrict M) → (μHE[n].restrict (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap a lam '' M)) univ = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * μHE[n] M ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → (μHE[n].restrict (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap a lam '' M)) (closedBall 0 R) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n) * (μHE[n] (M ∩ closedBall a (lam * R)) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal ((lam * R) ^ n))) ∧ (μHE[n].restrict (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap a lam '' M)) (ball 0 R) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n) * (μHE[n] (M ∩ ball a (lam * R)) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal ((lam * R) ^ n))) ∧ ∫⁻ y in closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R, ‖θ (a + lam • y) • ζ (a + lam • y) - θ a • ζ a‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n].restrict (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap a lam '' M)) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n) * ((∫⁻ x in M ∩ closedBall a (lam * R), ‖θ x • ζ x - θ a • ζ a‖ₑ ∂μHE[n]) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal ((lam * R) ^ n)))
